title: Prove repeat-aware matching balance for singleton walks (no κ)
body:
## Summary

A scoped combinatorial proof gives necessary repeated-visit budgets for closed singleton walks, answering one part of the repeat-capable contract left open in JoyboyBrian's PR5033. For the parity functional omitting coordinate v, write s_j for distinct visited vertices, m_j for fully occupied v-matching pairs, and R_j for repeated occurrences in class j. If the support meets at least two matching components,

```text
R_0 >= max(0, s_1-m_1-s_0)
R_1 >= max(0, s_0-m_0-s_1).
```

Contract the matching and count crossing incidences. Already consumed prefix repetitions give a necessary allocation interval when the final support is prescribed. A k-page hypercube book attains the parity-rounded bound for every k>=1, with 2k+2 distinct vertices and exact closed covering length 3k+(k mod 2).

The proof and verifier were produced by Nick Petalas. Credit JoyboyBrian / PR5033 for the repeat-capable question and engine gate; Ali Romman / PR5001 for simple-prefix capacity; Nick Petalas / PR4894 for simple matching balance; Mihir Srivastava, Ross Richardson, Nicholas Stone and the retained singleton-walk lineage. Matching contraction and closed-walk degree counting are classical. No predecessor executable or scientific suite is replayed. No global literature-priority claim is made.

## Evidence

Before, the existing matching-capacity gate explicitly bypassed repeat-capable targets and named a missing theorem. After, the new lemma quantifies a necessary repetition budget without requiring simplicity. It supplies a partial condition, not the full missing gate.

Local CPython 3.12.15 on macOS arm64, standard library only:

- Ten complete labeled-word domains check 25,680 closed words, including 24,832 with repeated vertices; 85,746 supported walk/coordinate cases and 768,060 prefix cases pass. Thirty one-component cases are explicitly outside the theorem's domain. The generated receipt binds all seven source files.
- Sixteen attaining book fixtures pass. An independent breadth-first search over support/endpoint states finds the optimum for the first five supports. Fifteen positive, boundary and rejection controls pass.
- Warning-strict direct normal and optimized checks pass in 5.465 and 5.464 seconds. Both registered commands pass through the package runner, whose complete run takes 11.648 seconds. These are local completion times, not performance claims.
- Committed bytes and declared source history pass for all eight package files at head `907f97726ec0a93772d573ab8a54133e645c70dc`. A read-only Git-free copy passes with empty PATH and leaves all eight files unchanged. Separate receipt, proof and code corruptions reject.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/repeat-matching-debt/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/repeat-matching-debt/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/repeat-matching-debt
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/repeat-matching-debt --check-source-history
```

An installed CPython 3.12 can replace the recorded interpreter path. Expected markers are `PASS_REPEAT_MATCHING_DEBT`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. The direct verifier writes no files and needs no Git or network.

## Limitations

Claim type: scoped written combinatorial proof with exact finite corroboration. The prefix corollary requires a prescribed final support. Passing the condition does not prove adjacency completion or universality. The attaining family is not asserted to be a universal paired-readout cover. No f(7) decision, seven-label census, runtime improvement, supplier admission, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Unknown-support inference, maintained-engine integration, dirty-state implementation, native/physical costs, complete invoices and the five framework assumptions remain open. No selected cold replay, predecessor scientific replay, Lean or Docker run was performed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Base is canonical main `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority revision 8, selected PR6030. The audit card is explicitly changed to original combinatorial work. Live claims, reservations, current main terms and open/merged/account work were checked; sparse notes, arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work remain coverage limits.

[Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19361705).

## Open next questions

Can one derive sound final-support bounds from one repeat-capable census target and maintain them cheaply enough to use the new inequality? Start with a named exact split and a separately priced per-node update. The prescribed-support condition alone does not justify enabling the old simple-prefix gate or expanding a census.

## Related open work

- #3899 audits the union-support prune on a tiny prefix-walk domain. This contribution proves a different new repetition bound and makes no predecessor audit or seven-label exclusion claim.
- #2134 studies a six-source word with one atomic TRIO call and permits repeated prefixes. This lemma concerns singleton steps and does not compute a comparable mixed-alphabet covering maximum.
- #2249 prices higher-arity six-source connector batches. This lemma changes no call alphabet or complete tariff and computes no comparable six-source optimum.
- #2817 prices two transfer-coupled mutable-source walks. The present single closed singleton-walk lemma has a different source contract and computes no comparable readout tariff.

- #6427 proves the exact restored tariff for visiting a complete fixed-weight mask layer, allowing intermediate masks and repeated visits. This contribution instead fixes a visited support and proves matching-based repetition constraints, with a hypercube-book attaining family; no common numerical instance is reported.

The completion refresh inspected this account's open PRs created since the advance CLAIM. PR6427 is the newly adjacent scope listed above. No additional computation audited another contribution or compared unrelated numbers.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks, `plan` and `replay (research/repeat-matching-debt)`, passed at exact head `907f97726ec0a93772d573ab8a54133e645c70dc` in [run 41537362488](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41537362488). The completed checks were read once; separate run metadata confirms success and the matching head. Hosted replay executes both registered warning-strict normal and optimized checks. All registered checks and recorded byte/source-history and Git-free checks also passed locally. CI certifies the finite replay and bindings, not independent human or formal proof-kernel acceptance. No failed or waived check remains.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. **Blast Radius:** isolated research package.

Only `research/repeat-matching-debt/` is added. Shared engines, frozen inputs, predecessor attribution and selected-frontier files are unchanged.
